authentication.notes: Both Segment and RudderStack use the Airship App Key and App Secret (or Master Secret) for authentication. Authentication is via Basic Auth (Base64 of appKey:appSecret) or Bearer token depending on the endpoint.

track.description: Segment track calls are received by Airship as Custom Events via POST /api/custom-events. The event properties are automatically added as properties on the custom event.
track.notes: Segment converts the event name to snake_case before sending. The userId from Segment maps to named_user_id in Airship. Track event properties are mapped to the body.properties object. Revenue-related properties map to body.value.

identify.description: Segment identify calls set Airship tags (for boolean traits) and attributes (for non-boolean traits) on the named user. Tags are managed via the Named Users Tags API, and attributes via the Named Users Attributes API.
identify.notes: Boolean traits (true/false) are sent as tags in the 'segment-integration' tag group. A true value creates a tag, a false value removes it. Non-boolean traits that are predefined in Airship are set as attributes. The userId maps to named_user_id. Segment maps reserved traits (firstName, lastName, email) to predefined Airship attributes.

track.description: RudderStack sends track events to Airship via the Custom Events API (POST /api/custom-events). The event name is automatically converted to snake_case.
track.notes: RudderStack converts the event name (e.g., 'Product Viewed') to snake_case ('product_viewed') before sending to Airship. The userId from RudderStack maps to named_user_id. Event properties are mapped to body.properties. RudderStack maps some event properties to Airship-specific fields (value, transaction, interaction_id, interaction_type, session_id).

identify.description: RudderStack identify calls set Airship tags (for boolean traits) and attributes (for non-boolean traits) on the named user. Tags use the 'rudderstack-integration' tag group (different from Segment's 'segment-integration').
identify.notes: RudderStack uses 'rudderstack-integration' tag group (vs Segment's 'segment-integration'). Boolean traits are sent as tags; non-boolean traits as attributes. RudderStack maps reserved traits (firstName→first_name, lastName→last_name, email→email) to predefined Airship attributes. The userId maps to named_user_id.

named_user_association.description: Both Segment and RudderStack map userId to Airship's named_user_id. A named user must exist in Airship for the corresponding userId value. Airship auto-creates named user records on first encounter.

tag_management.description: Boolean identify/group traits are sent as tags. Segment uses 'segment-integration' and 'segment-integration-group' tag groups; RudderStack uses 'rudderstack-integration' and 'rudderstack-integration-group'. True values add tags, false values remove tags. Non-boolean values are ignored for tags.
tag_management.gap_detail: Different tag group names between Segment and RudderStack. The tag group must be pre-created in Airship. Functionally equivalent but not field-level identical.

attribute_management.segment_approach: Non-boolean traits that match predefined Airship attributes are set as attributes via the Named Users Attributes API
attribute_management.rudderstack_approach: Non-boolean traits are set as attributes. Reserved traits are mapped to predefined Airship attributes (firstName→first_name, lastName→last_name, email→email)
attribute_management.description: Both platforms send non-boolean identify traits as Airship attributes. Attributes must be predefined in the Airship dashboard. Reserved Segment spec traits are mapped to Airship predefined attributes.

event_tracking.segment_approach: Track calls map to Airship Custom Events via POST /api/custom-events. Event name is converted to snake_case. Properties are mapped to body.properties.
event_tracking.rudderstack_approach: Track calls map to Airship Custom Events via POST /api/custom-events. Event name is converted to snake_case. Properties are mapped to body.properties.
event_tracking.description: Both platforms send track events as Airship Custom Events. Event names are converted to snake_case (e.g., 'Product Clicked' → 'product_clicked'). Event properties are forwarded in the body.properties object.

event_name_conversion.description: Both Segment and RudderStack convert event names to snake_case before sending to Airship (e.g., 'Product Viewed' → 'product_viewed', 'Order Completed' → 'order_completed').

batch_support.segment_approach: Segment (Actions) supports batching up to 100 events per request to the Custom Events API
batch_support.rudderstack_approach: RudderStack sends events via the Router with configurable batching per destination
batch_support.description: Both platforms support batching events to the Airship Custom Events API. The API accepts an array of custom event objects.
batch_support.gap_detail: Batching configuration and limits may differ. Segment Actions limits to 100 per batch.

known_gaps.description: Tag group names differ: Segment uses 'segment-integration', RudderStack uses 'rudderstack-integration'. Both require pre-creation in Airship dashboard.
known_gaps.impact: Migration requires creating the new tag group in Airship and potentially migrating existing tags.

known_gaps.description: RudderStack group calls use 'rudderstack-integration-group' tag group vs Segment's 'segment-integration-group'.
known_gaps.impact: Same as AIRSHIP-001 — tag group name difference for group-level tags.

known_gaps.description: Segment has both classic and Actions-based Airship destinations. RudderStack has a single cloud mode integration. The Actions variant supports additional mapping configurations (e.g., Register And Associate for SMS/email channels).
known_gaps.impact: RudderStack does not support the channel registration and association features available in Segment's Actions variant.

known_gaps.description: Segment's Actions variant supports additional actions: 'Register And Associate' for SMS/email channel registration, and 'Manage Tags' with configurable tag group override.
known_gaps.impact: These advanced features are not available in RudderStack's Airship integration.

matching_features: Tag management for boolean traits (identify → tags API)
Attribute management for non-boolean traits (identify → attributes API)
Reserved trait to predefined attribute mapping
Event property forwarding to custom event properties

notes: Airship is a shared cloud destination present in both RudderStack and Segment catalogs. Category: SMS & Push Notifications. Airship provides push messaging, SMS, email, and in-app messaging services. Both platforms use Airship's REST API (Custom Events API for track, Named Users Tags/Attributes API for identify). The key difference is the tag group naming convention: Segment uses 'segment-integration' while RudderStack uses 'rudderstack-integration'. Both require a named user to exist in Airship matching the userId. Segment has both classic and Actions-based variants; RudderStack supports cloud mode only. Payload-level parity is high for core track and identify functionality.
